One invoice is generated for each delivered route, with consignees and suppliers itemized within it. Invoice amounts are calculated from each delivery order's weight and rates. This is a browser-based invoice queue, not a posted accounting invoice. Orders on split routes are billed only against their delivery route.

Driver payroll

OPERATIONS INTELLIGENCE

Reports & mileage

Export demo shipment data; connect historical mileage and reports from the current system during integration.

Route profitability — revenue minus expenses

Revenue is attributed to the delivery route only (to avoid double-counting pickup and delivery). Includes the $150 minimum charge on non-prepaid orders. Expenses are recorded route expenses; unrecorded costs are not included.

Date filtering uses order delivery dates and expense dates. Expenses without a date appear only when no date filter is set.

RouteOrders delivered / assignedTotal revenueTotal expensesNet after expenses

Shipment totals by handling type

Totals are computed from editable demo shipments. Historical records will appear after legacy data mapping.

PARALLEL-RUN TRANSITION

Legacy GoLo modules

Keep existing workflows available while the new TMS is validated.
The original GoLo HTML files are preserved separately. Because this preview runs without your CGI server, legacy screens are represented as integration handoff links rather than live embedded data.

Existing modules to preserve

Migration readiness

1. Map existing customer, supplier, driver, route and manifest fields.

2. Connect the current CGI endpoints in read-only parallel mode.

3. Reconcile counts and identifiers before enabling writes.

4. Migrate invoice, payroll, mileage and expense workflows after validation.

Backend connection required

Data migration — secure backup

Back up the existing browser records and upload a protected snapshot to Supabase. This does not replace or delete any existing data. Keep the downloaded backup until migration is verified.
